title: Ordering, Paying, and Reporting Opinions
summary: Handling everyday service interactions and relaying what others say or think.
whyItMatters: A complete food-service interaction includes a clear order, clarification, problem repair, payment, and accurate reporting for other people.

mentalModel.title: Be specific at each step
mentalModel.content: Name the item, quantity, variation, and payment preference rather than relying on context.

mentalModel.title: Repair politely
mentalModel.content: State the mismatch, restate the original request, and ask for a solution.

ruleBlocks.title: Order with a complete noun phrase
ruleBlocks.content: Use Ich hätte gern, Ich nehme, or Für mich bitte plus the item and requested variation.

ruleBlocks.title: Confirm payment details
ruleBlocks.content: Ask together or separately, cash or card, and request a receipt when needed.

ruleBlocks.title: Relay another person's view
ruleBlocks.content: Use Er sagt, dass or Sie findet, dass and keep the subordinate verb final.

examples.de: Ich hätte gern die Suppe und ein Mineralwasser ohne Kohlensäure.
examples.en: I would like the soup and a still mineral water.

examples.de: Entschuldigung, ich habe den Salat ohne Käse bestellt.
examples.en: Excuse me, I ordered the salad without cheese.

examples.de: Meine Kollegin sagt, dass das Gemüse sehr gut schmeckt.
examples.en: My colleague says that the vegetables taste very good.

commonMistakes.correct: Use Ich hätte gern or Ich nehme in normal service situations.
commonMistakes.reason: The direct form can sound unnecessarily demanding.
Getrennt zahlen is the usual phrase.

comparisons.summary: The theme provides menus, break planning, and dietary vocabulary.
Dass supports reported opinions and service information.
